about: Sounds made from a written description (see generate_sounds.py). Each has the description, its length in seconds, how many variants to make, and its group.

rim.text: A basketball clanks hard off the steel rim of an outdoor playground hoop, loud metallic clang with a short rattle, close up, dry, no echo, one-shot

dunk.text: Slam dunk on an outdoor basketball hoop: the ball is slammed through, the rim snaps down and rattles hard, the net whips, heavy powerful impact, close up, one-shot

swish.text: A basketball swishes cleanly through a nylon net, nothing but net, crisp soft snap of the net, close up, dry, outdoors, one-shot

board.text: A basketball bangs off a metal playground backboard, hollow thud with a short rattle, close up, dry, outdoors, one-shot

dribble.text: One single hard basketball bounce on outdoor asphalt, close up, punchy, dry, no echo, one-shot

catch.text: Two hands catch a basketball, firm slap of palms on the leather ball, close up, dry, one-shot

pass.text: A quick basketball chest pass, short soft whoosh of the ball through the air, subtle, dry, one-shot

steal.text: A hand slaps a basketball away from a dribble, sharp quick smack on rubber, dry, one-shot

block.text: A blocked basketball shot, a hand swats the ball hard in mid-air, loud flat smack, punchy, dry, one-shot

land.text: Two sneakers land hard on asphalt after a jump, rubber soles thud with a little grit, close up, dry, one-shot

scuff.text: One quick sneaker scrape on a gritty outdoor asphalt basketball court, a sharp shuffle step, close up, dry, one-shot

whistle.text: A referee whistle, one short sharp blast, outdoors, dry, one-shot

buzzer.text: A basketball scoreboard buzzer, loud harsh horn held for one second and then it stops, one-shot

cheer.text: A small group of kids at a neighborhood playground cheer and clap after a basket, happy excited shouts, outdoors, natural, no music

cheerBig.text: A big group of kids go wild, cheering, screaming with joy and clapping after an amazing basketball play, outdoors on a playground, natural, no music

ooh.text: A group of kids react with a loud impressed ooooh after an amazing basketball move, short crowd reaction, outdoors, no music

aww.text: A group of kids groan awww in disappointment after a missed shot, short crowd reaction, outdoors, no music

ambPark.text: Peaceful neighborhood park ambience on a sunny afternoon: birds singing in pine trees, a light breeze in the branches, kids playing very far away, no music, no close voices

ambStreet.text: Quiet suburban street ambience on a summer afternoon: a lawn mower far away, a dog barking in the distance, a light breeze, a few birds, no music, no close voices

ambBeach.text: Beach ambience at sunset: gentle ocean waves rolling onto sand, a few seagulls in the distance, a light sea breeze, no music, no voices

ambSnow.text: High mountain ambience in winter: cold wind blowing over snow in soft gusts, quiet and airy, no music, no voices

ambCanyon.text: Desert canyon ambience: a dry warm wind, cicadas buzzing, a hawk calling far away, no music, no voices

packRip.text: Tearing open a foil trading card pack, a crisp foil rip, close up, dry, one-shot

cardFlip.text: A trading card is flipped over onto a table, a quick snappy card flick, close up, dry, one-shot
